prompt: One expression is missing from this working program. Fill in the blank -- answer with just the missing code.
explanation: \\d matches one digit and {n} repeats it exactly n times, so this pattern pins the shape to four digits, a hyphen, two digits, a hyphen and two digits. In a Java string literal the backslash itself must be escaped, which is why it is written \\d.
hints: You need a digit class repeated a fixed number of times, separated by literal hyphens -- and remember Java string literals eat one backslash.
